title: Weekend catch-up & misc TODOs
content:
Saturday quick brain dump (short, messy)

Morning run through (6:30)
- hydrate, caffeine, five deep breaths
- check sentry quick — focus on anything > P3 from last 24h

Top priorities for weekend catch-up
1) Follow up RINF-2145 (timeout spikes when autoscaler scales down) — re-check repro steps below. Aim: propose short-term mitigation (bump idle timeout) + long-term fix (graceful KV cache rehydrate).
2) Email infra about upcoming VPC maintenance window — draft below.
3) Finish tiny docs update for onboarding: add note about local KV cache env var (LOCAL_KV=1).

2-minute wins (do first)
- [ ] Reply to Leah about Monday stand changes
- [ ] Add a comment to PR #587 with the benchmark results I ran last week
- [ ] Toggle notification for #eng-platform to quiet for 2 hours

Errands / personal admin
- Passport renewal: scan current passport, need photo retake -> book nearby kiosk (Fri or Mon)
- Dentist appointment: confirm 4/2 10:30am (put on calendar)
- Grocery: almond milk, frozen berries, baby spinach, cold brew pods, cat litter (brand: clumpy-soft)

Notes / friction on RINF-2145
- Observed: latency tail and increase in 95/99th during 2-3am UTC when autoscaler trimmed nodes.
- Repro steps (rough):
  1) Deploy scaled cluster with min-nodes=3 max-nodes=10, heavy short-burst traffic to one model route.
  2) Wait for autoscaler to scale down to 3 nodes (idle period ~30m)
  3) Send 1000 concurrent short requests (~32 tokens) using clientA (same region)
  4) Observe a flurry of 504/timeout and bursty p99 latency for ~40s while KV caches are warmed and some pods OOM/killed by kube-probe flapping.
- Hypothesis: warm-up + rehydrate heavy-memory caches + scheduling lag + kube-probe threshold too aggressive for cold-started GPU containers
- Quick mitigation idea: extend liveness/readiness probe initialDelaySeconds by 20s + small jitter; bump scaling cooldown to 2m for routes tagged critical

Quick steps I tried (local)
- ran load generator (wrk2) against canary with retries disabled -> reproduced pattern locally with 10% failure rate
- captured logs: 2 pods showed GC spikes then eviction; one pod restarted because ephemeral /tmp filled from tmp files in model loader (need .cleanUpTempFiles)

Immediate next actions
- [ ] Draft mitigation RFC and share with Samir for review (due: Mon 9am) -> owner: Harper
- [ ] Add test in e2e-scaling-suite to simulate burst after scale-down -> owner: Samir
- [ ] Add probe tweak experiment to k8s-config branch -> owner: Harper

Email draft to infra (very rough)
Subject: Request: short maintenance window & probe tuning suggestion
Hi infra team,
Quick note - noticed recurring timeouts after autoscaler scale-downs for GPU nodes. Proposing a short config change: increase readiness/liveness initialDelaySeconds by 20s for inference pods while we iterate on cache rehydrate improvements. Happy to coordinate a short maintenance window to patch and monitor.
Thanks,
Harper

Meeting prep: Mon 10:00 sync w/ platform ops - talking points - summary of RINF-2145 (one-slide: reproducer, hypothesis, proposed mitigations) - ask: runway to roll small probe tweak to canary and monitor for 48h

Random notes to self
- Try using `LOCAL_KV=1` on laptop to speed dev loop; document weirdness with older cache format v1.
- Keep short checklist for on-call: 
  * look at autoscaler events
  * check node pressure metrics (memory, disk)
  * confirm pod restarts > 3 in 1h -> escalate

End-of-day personal checklist
- [ ] move laundry to washer
- [ ] water plants
- [ ] book passport photo

Okay. Done for now. Don't forget to breathe.

(If this is useful, convert the RINF-2145 notes into confluence page and link; otherwise keep as ephemeral scratch)
